label: myenergi zappi v2.1 solar-aware EV charger
description: myenergi zappi v2.1 is a 7 kW single-phase or 22 kW three-phase EV charger that diverts surplus solar generation with ECO and ECO+ modes and a grid current sensor. It is one of the better-connected chargers: an RJ45 Ethernet port plus built-in 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi up to 150 Mbps, with a separate 868/915 MHz proprietary radio for myenergi sensors and remote monitoring.
